lib/paint/painting: A painting places its deposits' stamps with the brush, along the stroke its hand moves.
lib/paint/photoshop-brushes: A Photoshop preset is normalized into a StampBrush, the engine's brush.
lib/paint/procreate-brushes: A Procreate brush's settings are read into a StampBrush, the engine's brush.
lib/paint/brush-packs: A pack's importer writes each brush it reads as a StampBrush.
lib/paint/style: A style names the brushes its paintings use.
lib/paint/brush-fidelity: A target is read and measured as a StampBrush paints, its reach and dual taken from the brush.
lib/paint/studies: A study paints its passages with a style's brushes.
lib/paint/gate: The GPU gate paints with brushes, synthetic and a pack's, to hold the renderer to its baselines.
lib/paint/animation: Motion's specs paint their test groups with a synthetic brush, as the painting's own specs do.
lib/paint/document: A document lays its marks through the brush's placements, stroke points, hands and assets.
lib/paint/shot: A shot hands its documents the brushes their refs name, as its styles carry them.
